title: Tire Wear and Thermals Node-Thermal Friction — Compat Tires
tag_line: Extra NTF tires + GT3 Baseline/Endurance mirrors — needs the core heat/wear mod
message:
[B]Tire Wear and Thermals Node-Thermal Friction — Compat Tires[/B]
Extra tire parts and Scintilla GT3 configs that mirror the official GT3 pack. This is [B]not[/B] the heat/wear mod — install [B]core Node-Thermal Friction[/B] first: [URL]https://www.beamng.com/resources/tire-wear-and-thermals-ntf.39082/[/URL]

[HR][/HR]
[B]Requires[/B] the core heat/wear/apps mod: [URL]https://www.beamng.com/resources/tire-wear-and-thermals-ntf.39082/[/URL]

[HR][/HR]
[B]What you get[/B]
• Extra street tires for stock wheels: Sport Plus, Track Day, Hard, and Medium. Stock Sport / Race / Standard stay in the list.
• Scintilla GT3 NTF slicks: Hard, Medium, Soft, and Supersoft (parts — for AMD / Parts menu)
• Pigniteon ETKC Grip-All GT3 NTF tires
• Same 3D models as stock / the car pack — only the tire files are new

[B]Scintilla GT3 configs (two only — mirrors the GT3 pack)[/B]
Names follow the factory Scintilla GT3 Racing Parts pair, with NTF in the title:
• [B]GT3 NTF - Baseline (Sequential)[/B] — mirrors [I]GT3 - Baseline (Sequential)[/I]
• [B]GT3 NTF - Endurance (Sequential)[/B] — mirrors [I]GT3 - Endurance (Sequential)[/I]
Needs [I]Scintilla GT3 Racing Parts[/I]. Compound / Quali extras live in AMD Customs Collection, not this pack.

[HR][/HR]
[B]How to use[/B]
1. Install [B]Tire Wear and Thermals Node-Thermal Friction[/B] (core): [URL]https://www.beamng.com/resources/tire-wear-and-thermals-ntf.39082/[/URL]
2. Install [B]this[/B] Compat Tires pack.
3. For GT3: also install [I]Scintilla GT3 Racing Parts[/I] and/or [I]Pigniteon ETK Racing[/I] (for the 3D models).
4. On Scintilla, pick [B]GT3 NTF - Baseline[/B] or [B]GT3 NTF - Endurance[/B]. On other cars: Parts → tires → pick a name ending in [B]NTF[/B].

[HR][/HR]
[B]Why a second download?[/B]
If these tires lived inside the core zip, BeamNG would hide the apps. Keep this pack separate.

[HR][/HR]
[B]Credits[/B]
• Scintilla GT3 Racing Parts by Exchy / Turbo49 / Cyborella — NTF configs are mirrors, not official pack files
• Listing shots of the [I]Civetta Scintilla GT3[/I] used with [B]courtesy permission[/B]
• Vehicle pack: [URL]https://www.beamng.com/resources/scintilla-gt3-racing-parts.23027/[/URL]
• Pigniteon ETK Racing — credit as on that pack’s listing
• Does [B]not[/B] ship anyone else’s models, textures, or sounds
